description: Estimate land transfer tax on a home purchase in any of the 13 provinces and territories (incl. Toronto MLTT, Montreal welcome tax) with first-time buyer rebates, the transfer registration fee (to register the deed) and the total due at registration. AB, SK, NL and the territories charge no land transfer tax, only the registration fee. The mortgage registration fee is not included.

inToronto.description: Ontario only: property is within the City of Toronto (adds the municipal LTT)

quebecMunicipality.description: Quebec only: 'montreal' = Montreal's welcome-tax brackets (default); 'other' = provincial base schedule, for municipalities without higher rates above $500,000

name: land_transfer_tax
title: Canadian Land Transfer Tax Calculator
